identity.name: Walnut Creek
identity.notes: Walnut Creek is a residential neighborhood in Pembroke Pines, a city in Broward County, Florida, situated in the western part of the city near the Miami-Dade County line. It is a family-oriented, single-family home community. Note: verified, community-specific data (exact HOA dues, CDD assessments, and on-site amenities) is limited in public sources, so figures below are approximate and, where given, reflect the broader Pembroke Pines area rather than the community itself.

fees.note: Monthly HOA fees for single-family homes typically reported in the $298-$350 range in recent real estate listings; higher for condos. Exact current fees, transfer fees, capital contributions, and special assessments not detailed in public sources reviewed by this site. HOA: Walnut Creek Community Association, Inc., 7500 NW 20th St, Pembroke Pines FL 33024; managed by Campbell Property Management per this source (conflicts with hoa-agent.com, which lists Hawthorne Management). Retrieved 2026-07-11T12:00:00Z, confidence 0.6 (reputable HOA info aggregator, not official).

Resident-submitted fee report of $250/mo (profile combines public records and resident-submitted data; not guaranteed). No special assessment signals reported. Retrieved 2026-07-11T12:00:00Z, confidence 0.4 (resident-submitted/unverified).

Official CDD site: all property owners are subject to annual assessments in two components - Operation & Management (O&M) of District improvements and Bond Debt Service (principal & interest) on the Special Assessment Bond Series 2010, scheduled to mature May 2040. Collected by the Broward County Tax Collector; appears under the non-ad valorem tax section of the property tax bill. Dollar amount per parcel not stated on the page. Retrieved 2026-07-11T12:00:00Z, confidence 0.9 (official CDD source).

amenities.detail: Clubhouse with pools, heated spa, gym, aerobics room, large lobby/banquet hall, tennis courts, and toddler playground (official community TownSq site). Retrieved 2026-07-11T12:00:00Z, confidence 0.8 (official community site).
Pools with heated spa in clubhouse. Retrieved 2026-07-11T12:00:00Z, confidence 0.8.
Gym and aerobics room in clubhouse. Retrieved 2026-07-11T12:00:00Z, confidence 0.8.
Huge lobby that doubles as a banquet hall for special occasions. Retrieved 2026-07-11T12:00:00Z, confidence 0.8.
Tennis courts at clubhouse. Retrieved 2026-07-11T12:00:00Z, confidence 0.8.
Restricted-access gated community; the CDD is responsible for security within the community. Retrieved 2026-07-11T12:00:00Z, confidence 0.8.
Gated with manned security and patrol; CDD responsibility for lakes, storm drains, and security. Retrieved 2026-07-11T12:00:00Z, confidence 0.6 (reputable aggregator).
CDD owns and maintains common areas including eight lakes, berm, and storm drains; professionally landscaped grounds. Retrieved 2026-07-11T12:00:00Z, confidence 0.8.
